test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 6th December 2021 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: A fan is sold at a profit of 20%. If Rs 150 is reduced from both the cost price and the selling price of the fan, the profit will be 5% more. Find the original cost price (in Rs) of the fan.
solution: **Formula:** SP - CP = P, where SP = Selling Price CP = Cost Price P = Profit Calculation: Let the cost price be Rs a. SP for 20% profit = 1.2 × a = 1.2a
